text: Testing plays a key role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of code, like a single function, to make sure they work correctly. Integration tests go further and check how different parts of a system work together. Many developers use test-driven development, or TDD, where they write tests before writing the actual code. This approach helps them think clearly about what the code should do. Thanks to testing, teams can find bugs early and fix them quickly. As a result, developers feel more confident when they change or add new features, because they know their tests will catch serious mistakes.
